note_45min: 45 minutes is a resample only; Kite serves 1/3/5/10/15/30/60 and day.
coverage: spot minute 2026-02-13..2026-08-14; futures minute 2026-07-01..2026-09-04, so confluence cells rest on ~6 weeks
caveats: Six months of intraday is a fraction of the 2018-2026 daily span. Evidence here is weaker in both directions.
Confluence rests on ~6 weeks of overlap. Those cells are a hint.
Measures the UNDERLYING's move — an upper bound on a long-premium CE/PE position, never an estimate of one.
Many cells means multiple testing: a scattering of positives is what noise produces. Consistency across timeframes is the thing to look for.

cost_hurdle_bps.note: Futures round trip at one lot, slippage 0.0002, entry price = exit price. A bought option round trip costs several times more — the bid-ask on premium alone routinely exceeds this.

reading: In-sample 67% of cells positive (mean +1.61 bps); holdout 40% (mean -1.66 bps). 40% is BELOW the 50% a coin flip gives, so out of sample there is no edge to find at any timeframe — the in-sample tilt does not carry.
The short side is the worst axis anywhere: 18.1% of holdout cells positive, mean -4.58 bps. Consistent with every earlier study.
Confluence does not rescue it intraday: 35.4% positive, mean -2.42 bps, WORSE than spot_only's 37.5% / -1.03. On daily it helped slightly; here it does not.

Even the best axis — long, 61.1% positive — averages +1.27 bps against a ~7 bps futures round trip. The edge is 5-10x too small to pay for the trading before the option leg's spread and theta are considered at all.
